title: Modern Luxury Home close to Broadway
description:
Step into luxury with this stunning 3 bedroom home, nestled in the desirable Cumberland Heights neighborhood, just 5 minutes from the iconic Broadway, The Modern Luxury House embodies sophisticated living at its finest. This chic retreat comfortably sleeps 12 guests and offers convenient parking for two vehicles.

The space
The Modern Luxury Home offers four stories of exceptional living space, including three spacious bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom for added privacy. The open-concept kitchen and living area provide the perfect setting for gathering and relaxing, but the real showstopper is the rooftop enjoying the view. Every room is a blend of comfort and style. Whether you're planning a bachelorette trip, birthday celebration, or a large group getaway, The Modern Luxury Home is the ultimate destination for memorable moments.

Guest access
Things You'll Love:
◆ Quick drive away from iconic Broadway and other Nashville spots
◆ Rooftop with skyline views and hot tub.
◆ Gourmet kitchen featuring high-end appliances.
◆ Open-concept living area features a spacious oversized sectional and a wall-mounted smart television
◆ Garage and driveway parking, and free street parking for additional cars.

Sleeping Arrangements:

◆ Bedroom 4 - Queen Bed, Bunk Bed with Full and single bed combo, 2 queen air mattresses with ensuite full bathroom

Forth Floor
